title: 2027 Ireland Graduate Rail Project Management Career Path: Transport
description: Before making an application, please browse all graduate opportunities available as we will only accept **one application** per candidate. Once you have made an application you will not be able to make changes to your selection or make a new application. The exception is if we open new vacancies in the new year. **To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying** **as early as possible, as positions will close once filled.** **Application process** * Upload CV and cover letter, detailing motivations and suitability for the opportunity. * Online strengths-based assessment This opportunity uses a single-stage strengths-based interview as part of the selection process. Start your career with a global, employee-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one. **Job Description** Rail Project Manager – Dublin As a member of the Project Management Team, you will work within a team developing and delivering Rail projects from inception to handover and completion. This will include scheme definition, feasibility, design development, procurement and Contract Administration. Your role will require you to liaise closely with multiple stakeholders and clients, co-ordinate multi-disciplinary design teams, draft and manage the production of reports and tender documents, monitor cost and schedule and manage the Health & Safety and Quality Assurance aspects of projects. You will be confident in contributing to a technical team and as a key member of a project team, liaising directly with the client, project sponsors and key stakeholders when necessary. **Candidate Specification** At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in. To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience **(excluding placements** ) and have a bachelors / masters degree (obtained no earlier than 2025) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines: * Project management Engineering In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests - such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects. We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story. We are looking for graduates with the following strengths: * Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently. * Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues. * Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity. * Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving. **AI Usage** At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application. **Accessibility** We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help. **About Your Development** A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald. **Our social side** Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in. From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community. It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits. **Agile working** At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust. **Equality, diversity, and inclusion** We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute. **We offer some fantastic benefits including:** * Biannual salary reviews: We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period. * Flexible working * Pension matched up to 7% of base salary * Competitive annual leave * An annual professional institution subscription * Life insurance * Income continuance * Enhanced Paternity leave * Annual company performance bonus scheme – Subject to company performance * Cycle to work scheme * Travel TaxSaver tickets * Commitment to Continuing Professional Development – we are accredited by Engineers Ireland * A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options. **Networks, communities, and social outcomes** * Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities. * Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes. Location(s): Dublin, IE Contract Type: Permanent Work Pattern: Full Time Market: Transport Discipline: Railways Job Ref: 17506 Recruiter Contact: earlycareers.recruitment@mottmac.com

title: Account Management Representative
description: **Job Description** **Working Hours: 7:00-15:30** **Company Overview** At Fidelity, we help 23 million people invest their life savings, 20,000 businesses manage their employee benefits programs, 10,000 advisors and institutions needing innovative technology solutions to invest their clients’ money. To do this well, we place a high degree of value in nurturing a work environment that attracts the best talent and reflects our commitment to being an employer of choice. Fidelity established its Ireland presence in 1996 and we currently employ over 1000 staff across IT and Operations & Corporate Shared Services with offices in Dublin (Citywest) and Galway (Parkmore East). The successful candidate will work within an exciting, fast-paced and growing Operations & Corporate Shared Services environment. Fidelity is a privately owned company, committed to innovation and to providing the best customer experience in financial services. The **Expertise** We’re Looking For * 0-2 years’ experience, preferably within financial services and/or a shared service model The **Purpose** of Your Role The Account Maintenance team accurately maintains new and existing brokerage accounts and all related features for the National Financial business unit. Representatives utilize multiple systems, (e.g. FBSI, XTRAC) to analyze account application requests and maintenance forms accurately and action them expeditiously. The **Skills** You Bring * Your ability to quickly organize and prioritize multiple tasks * Your ability to take initiative and to work under tight deadlines in a dynamic team environment * Be analytical and possess good problem solving skills * Be technically oriented, with strong MS Office/PC skills * Your excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills * Be motivated and show desire to learn about the business and new technologies The **Value** You Deliver * By processing new account application and maintenance forms, you provide a valuable service to our customers, and help to maintain the firm’s reputation for quality * The relationships that you establish with our US business partners will help ensure adherence to Operations policies and procedures, and will enhance the reputation of the Account Maintenance team in Ireland * Prioritizing and managing escalations/exceptions that are received from NF Client Managers and the teams’ US business partners * Managing and reviewing documented client exception lists to ensure client-specific needs are met * Participating in various projects and process improvement initiatives focused on improving the existing workflow, quality, efficiency and policy & procedures How Your Work **Impacts** the Organization Operations and Services Group (OSG) is a division of Fidelity Institutional and provides superior customer service to Fidelity businesses through innovation, dedication and commitment to excellence. In operating locations across the US and in Ireland, OSG plays a critical role by processing every transaction into Fidelity and out to customers through the brokerage platform. OSG provides securities execution, clearance, and risk management services to retail, institutional, and correspondent clients. Closing Date Closing date for applications is **30th October 2026** For information about working at Fidelity, visit www.fidelityinvestments.ie. *Fidelity Investments is an equal opportunity employer* **Category** Brokerage Operations

title: Associate Systems Administrator
description: **Who We Are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years. **What We Do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role Overview** The Associate Systems Administrator is an entry-level position within the IT Systems team based in our Dublin office. This role serves as a critical bridge between our IT Service Desk and Global Systems functions, primarily focusing on supporting our EU and UK-based employees. You will work closely with the IT Service Desk team to resolve technical escalations while aligning with US-based systems engineers to maintain global applications, security policies, patching standards, and network infrastructure across our European locations. This role requires a blend of operational support, technical curiosity, and a commitment to maintaining a secure, highly available environment. On Call work may be required with this roll as needed by the business. In addition to the responsibilities above, this role also requires regular physical activity, including moving around the office to assist with IT or AV event related tasks, lifting and carrying equipment (upwards of 50lbs), moving tables and chairs, and plugging in devices under desks and other confined spaces. The Associate Systems Administrator must be able to perform these duties safely and efficiently as part of their responsibilities. **What You'll Do** **System Administration & Support** * Perform daily monitoring, management, and troubleshooting for core corporate enterprise software platforms. * Assist with the configuration, deployment, and maintenance of identity platforms and collaboration tools. * Follow established change management procedures for system updates and modifications. * Maintain accurate system documentation, including runbooks and knowledge base articles for the Service Desk. **Workspace & Endpoint Management** * Support the administration of Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune. * Assist in managing end-user devices, including software deployments, VDI deployment and desktop configurations. * Help implement and enforce security measures like software patches and OS updates. **Networking & Infrastructure** * Provide first-level support for network escalations, including Wi-Fi, VPN, and firewall issues. * Assist with basic network troubleshooting and performance monitoring for EU office environments. * Support the setup and maintenance of local network hardware under senior guidance. **Identity & Security Compliance** * Manage user lifecycles within identity platforms (e.g., Okta) to ensure appropriate access controls. * Contribute to incident response efforts by participating in a regional on-call rotation. * Review incoming IT requests to ensure alignment with company Information Security and governance policies. **What You'll Bring** **Required Skills & Experience** * Foundational experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms such as Okta or OneLogin. * Proficiency working within enterprise ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian/Jira). * Experience with enterprise collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, and Slack. * Exposure to MDM tools such as Microsoft Intune or Jamf. * Basic understanding of enterprise networking principles and troubleshooting techniques.Demonstrated ability to document technical processes and follow standard operating procedures. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Audiovisual (AV) setup and troubleshooting for conference rooms. * Basic administration experience with enterprise cloud-based telephony systems (e.g., Dialpad). * A background in Systems Administration (min 2 years experience) and some experience with IT support or service desk operations. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones. The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles. Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Position Pay Range €38.000—€48.000 EUR **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

title: Business Development & Commercial Operations Executive
description: F.E.W. Ltd. is a growing electrical wholesaler supplying electrical contractors and commercial projects across Ireland. We specialise in electrical containment products and associated materials, with a focus on competitive pricing, reliable supply and building long-term relationships with our customers. As the business continues to expand, we are looking for a commercially minded and motivated individual to join our team in Arklow. This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, growing business in a varied role combining business development, sales, customer relationships and commercial operations. Rather than being confined to one department, you will gain exposure to how a business operates, how new opportunities are developed and how day-to-day decisions contribute to growth. We welcome applications from recent graduates, people studying business or related disciplines, and candidates at the beginning of their careers who are keen to develop practical commercial experience. The Role Working closely with the management team, you will help identify new business opportunities, develop customer relationships, support existing accounts and improve the processes that keep the business running efficiently. The role will evolve as the business grows, providing opportunities to take ownership of projects, develop commercial skills and progress within the company. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Sales - Identify and research potential customers, including electrical contractors and commercial construction businesses. - Support lead generation, prospecting and the development of new customer accounts. - Help prepare quotations, follow up on opportunities and progress enquiries into orders. - Research market trends, competitors and opportunities to expand our product offering and customer base. - Build and maintain professional relationships with customers and suppliers. Customer & Commercial Operations - Assist with customer enquiries, quotations, order processing and account development. - Coordinate with suppliers, warehouse staff and delivery operations to help ensure orders are fulfilled efficiently. - Monitor customer requirements, outstanding quotations and opportunities for repeat business. - Assist with product information, technical documentation and commercial submissions where required. Business Operations & Improvement - Work across different areas of the business to understand how sales, purchasing, stock and logistics fit together. - Help improve internal processes, organisation, stock management and reporting. - Identify practical ways to improve efficiency, customer service and profitability. - Assist with business development projects, new product introductions and initiatives supporting the company's next stage of growth. Who We're Looking For We are more interested in your attitude, commercial instincts and willingness to learn than in years of experience. You may be a suitable candidate if you: - Have recently graduated, are studying, or have experience in business, business management, marketing, sales or a related area. - Are interested in how businesses grow, win customers and operate profitably. - Have strong communication and organisational skills. - Are comfortable speaking with customers, building relationships and following up on opportunities. - Can use initiative, solve problems and manage competing priorities. - Are confident using computers and willing to learn business systems and processes. - Want a varied role with real responsibility rather than a narrowly defined position. Previous sales experience, knowledge of the electrical or construction sectors, and experience with business software would be beneficial, but are not essential. What We Offer - The opportunity to join a growing Irish business at an exciting stage of its development. - Practical experience across sales, business development and commercial operations. - Direct exposure to business decision-making and the commercial side of the construction supply industry. - Increasing responsibility and the opportunity to take ownership of projects. - A role with scope to develop into a more senior commercial or business development position as the company grows. How to Apply If you are ambitious, commercially minded and interested in helping build a growing business, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a brief introduction outlining your background, interests and why this opportunity appeals to you. Pay: €28,300.00-€35,000.00 per year Benefits: * Company pension * Food allowance * Free or subsidised travel * On-site parking Work Location: In person

title: Collections Assistant
description: #### **Company Description** The Royal College of Physicians of Ireland is a postgraduate medical training college dedicated to ensuring that doctors have the skills to provide patients with the best possible care. Founded in 1654, the college supports doctors to enhance their skills, competencies, and professionalism throughout their working lives. Through its Faculties and Institutes, The Royal College of Physicians of Ireland, offers medical training programmes, examinations, diplomas, and educational courses to equip doctors with the skills and knowledge they need to care for patients and run safe and efficient healthcare systems. It also offers a range of educational diplomas and courses for learners in the wider healthcare sector. #### **Job Description** **Position** Collections Assistant **Contract:** 1 Year contract **Reporting to:** Collections Manager **Salary:** €31,000 **Closing date:** 2 November 2026 at 16:00 **Start Date:** The successful applicant will start in January 2027 Post Summary RCPI’s Heritage Centre manages an internationally important collection of archives, printed material and objects relating to the history of medicine and medical education in Ireland. We are Ireland’s only accredited medical museum. As one of the strategic aims of the College we are developing a publicly accessible museum. These roles will carry out cataloguing, photographing, and packing of our object collections. Standard Duties of the Post Duties will involve, but are not limited to: * Cataloguing objects using Axiell Collections. * Photographing objects, uploading digital assets to Preservica & linking to Axiell Collections records. * Packing objects in preparation for decant. #### **Requirements** Person Specification * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. * Ability to work in an organised and productive way, with strong attention to detail. * Self-starter with high motivation and the ability to work flexibly on own initiative to achieve goals within agreed timeframes. * Excellent IT skills. Practical experience of using collection management systems or databases, especially Axiell Collections, is desirable. * Post-graduate qualification in museums, archivesor related field, or equivalent experience. * Knowledge of collections care practices and demonstrable experience of how this applies. Competencies: * Communication and Interpersonal * Attention to Detail * IT Literacy * Cataloguing * Collaboration #### **Why us?** **Leave:** We offer 21 days annual leave with an additional 3-4 college days as well as long service leave to all employees. We also provide support for staff with Maternity, Sick, Parents, and Parental leave. **Wellbeing:** An Employee Assistance Programme with Spectrum Life is available to all staff members as well as annual flu vaccine. **Pension:** A defined contribution pension scheme of 1.5% Employee contribution and RCPI contribution from commencement date with an increase after 18 months **Flexible Benefit:** Pro-rata €1,500 annual flexible benefit upon completion of a successful probationary period. **Life Assurance:** 4 times your annual salary. **Learning & Development:** We offer CPD options including study leave and access to our internal LMS Training system. **Diversity and Inclusion:** RCPI recognises the importance of equality, diversity, and inclusion. We were recently awarded a Silver accreditation from Investors in Diversity. We are an open and inclusive organisation that celebrates and welcomes diversity. We lead initiatives that support, promote and demonstrate a culture of mutual respect, inclusivity, and diversity, as outlined in our Diversity and Inclusion policy. #### **Accommodations** The Royal College of Physicians of Ireland is an inclusive employer and in line with our policies you are invited to disclose any reasonable accommodations you require for applying, interviewing or working with RCPI. Please be assured this information will be treated as confidential and not used for the purpose of selection. If you have any queries, please contact Suzann Donnelly at suzanndonnelly@rcpi.ie. #### **About us** The Royal College of Physicians of Ireland is a postgraduate medical training college dedicated to ensuring that doctors have the skills to provide patients with the best possible care. Founded in 1654, the college supports doctors to enhance their skills, competencies, and professionalism throughout their working lives. Through its Faculties and Institutes, The Royal College of Physicians of Ireland, offers medical training programmes, examinations, diplomas, and educational courses to equip doctors with the skills and knowledge they need to care for patients and run safe and efficient healthcare systems. It also offers a range of educational diplomas and courses for learners in the wider healthcare sector.

title: Graduate AI Engineer
description: **Junior AI Engineer** **Job Description** My client, a professional services organisation, is seeking a Junior AI Engineer to join a growing technology and automation function, supporting the development of AI-enabled applications, integrations and intelligent workflow solutions. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test and support internal AI-powered tools and workflow automations that improve business processes and reduce manual activity. * Build and maintain APIs and integrations that enable AI models to interact securely with enterprise applications, data sources and business systems. * Develop production-quality solutions using technologies such as Python and Rust, with exposure to TypeScript and Node.js where appropriate. * Support the development of AI agent workflows, including prompt design, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and appropriate technical safeguards. * Work with Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph to develop integrated automation solutions. * Use Git and GitHub for source control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD processes and general development collaboration. * Produce clear technical documentation, including architecture notes, support documentation, implementation guidance and operational procedures. * Engage with tool calling and the limitations of large language models. * Working knowledge of Rust, ideally demonstrated through an academic, personal or open-source project, together with an understanding of concepts such as ownership, error handling and dependency management. * Strong Python fundamentals and familiarity with modern Python project, environment and dependency management tools. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including working with JSON, authentication mechanisms, error handling and API documentation. * Good understanding of core software engineering practices including Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph or Microsoft Copilot. * TypeScript and Node.js development experience. * Understanding of SQL, document processing, vector degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or another related discipline. * Candidates with a strong demonstrable portfolio of equivalent technical work may also be considered. **Working Hours & Benefits** * Permanent position with standard Monday-to-Friday working hours. * Opportunity to join a developing AI and automation capability at an early stage. * Broad exposure to AI engineering, software development, APIs, cloud technologies and enterprise automation. * Opportunity to work directly with experienced technology leadership and contribute to engineering standards and ways of working. * Continued professional development in a rapidly evolving area of technology. * Exposure to a range of modern AI models, platforms and development tools. **How to Apply** To apply for this role, please submit your updated CV. If your skills and experience match job requirements, you will be contacted to discuss your application in detail. **Similar Roles Open** As a specialised recruitment agency, we also have several other permanent and contract IT roles available. title: Graduate Business Development Representative (SaaS Sales)

title: Graduate Clinical Specialist – Cardiac Physiology
description: **Graduate Clinical Specialist – Cardiac Physiology** **Interested in cardiac physiology and how medical technology supports patient care? Start your career in clinical technology and make a real difference in hospital settings.** I’m looking for a Graduate Clinical Specialist to join a globally recognised pharmaceutical and medical technology company working closely with healthcare professionals and supporting the use of innovative technologies in cardiac care. title: Graduate Commissioning, Qualification and Validation (CQV) Engineer
description: **Application Closing Date: 23rd October 2026 - Please note we reserve the right to close roles sooner, so Early Application is encouraged.** **Start date: 13th September 2027** Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. **Role description:** Our two-year Graduate GROW Programme supports your transition from student to professional, sitting along client work and real projects from day one. Each graduate’s journey is unique, shaped by their chosen specialism and the variety of projects they contribute to. You will build your technical expertise by contributing to meaningful client engagements and project work, whilst business acumen and professional skills will be developed through centrally delivered graduate cohort training. Although there are no formal rotations, graduates are encouraged and supported by their managers to proactively seek opportunities, to broaden their experience and support their development. During this two-year programme you will develop core engineering and consulting techniques that can be applied while working with our clients in the UK&I and potentially even some of our international clients around the globe. **Role accountabilities:** As a Commissioning, Qualification and Validation (CQV) Engineer, you will join a team delivering projects across the pharmaceutical sector, including Biotech, API, Sterile Manufacturing and Oral Solid Dosage facilities. Working alongside experienced engineers and project teams, you will support the preparation of qualification protocols in line with client templates, procedures and regulatory guidelines using digital validation platforms. You will help ensure the technical accuracy and quality of project deliverables, working closely with quality teams to ensure standard operating procedures are followed and all relevant documentation and checklists are completed. You will contribute to the review of vendor submittals and construction turnover packages, support mechanical completion activities, report progress to internal teams and participate in project planning meetings. You will also have opportunities to execute qualification protocols in the field, verifying that systems are installed to specification and operate in accordance with user requirements, while gaining valuable experience across a variety of pharmaceutical manufacturing and utility systems. Accepted degrees: Science, Biotechnology, Process & Chemical, Biopharmaceutical, Mechanical Engineering **Qualifications & Experience:** * You will be graduating in 2027 or have recently graduated in 2025 or 2026, with at least a 2:2 in a relevant master's or bachelor's degree * You will demonstrate typical Arcadian skills including Resilience, Creativity, Analytical Thinking and being a Team Player * You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to use your technical knowledge to influence and consult stakeholders. * Willing to travel and stay away from home when required (where possible we embrace virtual working) **Why Arcadis?** We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. **Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging** We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. title: Graduate Development Programme - Sales Operations
description: **Summary** *From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl.* With over 7,000 colleagues across our stores, warehouses and offices in Ireland and Northern Ireland we are a big and ambitious team. We know our people are our greatest asset and our success is down to the commitment and dedication of our team. **Training and Development** At Lidl, your career isn’t just a job - it’s an investment. We’re big on growth, and we give you all the support, structure, and hands-on experience you need to level up both personally and professionally. As the **only City & Guilds/ILM Accredited Graduate Programme in Ireland** , our 18-month Graduate Management Development Programme is built entirely around *you* . **What makes it different?** * Tailored To You: Enjoy a bespoke training plan mapped to your unique skills and long-term career goals. * Real-World Experience: Get stuck into our stores and distribution centers to learn the heart of our business from the ground up. * Blended Learning: Experience dynamic, structured on-the-job training combined with industry-leading modules. We don't just hire graduates—we build future leaders. Ready to launch yours? **Sales Operations** Sales Operations graduates will gain comprehensive experience working across our stores and our Head Office operations. You will spend time directly in our stores learning all the key retail processes and driving turnover growth through exceptional customer service and standards. In Head Office, the Sales Operations department supports our store teams to achieve their KPIs, driving operational efficiency and delivering high-impact initiatives across all shop floors nationwide. During your rotation in Sales Operations, you will drive business success through four cour focus areas: Gatekeeper Role: Ensure high-quality Sales Operations standards and adherence to the most efficient procedures across all stores. Project Collaboration: Actively participate in Sales Operations projects to drive continuous improvement in store operations and overall performance. KPI and Motion Studies: Measure KPI performance and support with Time in Motion studies for precise data analysis. International Trials: Support with international trials to evaluate and roll out best practices across our store network. Covering both areas of retail operations will ensure a bigger picture view of our business and ultimately improve your chances of success. What you'll need * An expected or attained 2.1 Honours Level 8 degree * Full driver’s license is required * Creative and innovative approach to problem solving and process improvement * Flexibility to travel or relocate within Ireland is required. Once your store training is complete, you will be based in our head office and must be able to commute to Dublin * Motivation and drive * Strong personal, communication and presentation Skills * Work experience or experience abroad * German is an advantage but not a necessity What you'll receive We offer a competitive and transparent salary system, that ensures pay equality across all positions at Lidl * €45,500 per annum pro rata * 20 days holidays per annum pro rata * Private employee medical insurance * Flexible start and finish times * City & Guilds/ILM assured programme * Initial training and on-going development from an experienced team member * Responsibility for and involvement in projects with real business impact * Excellent opportunities for career progression * Bespoke training plan depending on current skills and career path * One-to-one coaching available from a qualified coach in the business * A vast array of training and development opportunities from our in-house training catalogue including Leadership Development Programmes * Masterclasses with renowned business experts * Director and graduate mentorship programme * Modern office facility with free parking * On-site gym and canteen * Up to 2 days remote working per week * Mobile and broadband discounts with Three network * Unlock a flex pot allowance to spend on a selection of benefits after 6 months of service Lidl is an equal opportunities employer. We value diversity and inclusion in our workplace and want to ensure that all applicants have the same opportunity regardless of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, age, disability, race, religious belief, political opinion or membership of the traveller community.

title: Kepak Supply Chain Graduate Programme 2027 - Ireland
description: **Role Purpose** The Supply Chain Graduate programme at Kepak offers an in-depth experience across the various facets of our supply chain and operations. Graduates will be immersed in the end-to-end process, from production to customer fulfilment, gaining a comprehensive understanding of how different teams and functions interact to maintain inventory, ensure product quality, and meet customer expectations. The role is designed to develop well-rounded professionals who can navigate the complexities of a fast-paced, data-driven environment, ultimately preparing them for leadership positions within the company. **Key Responsibilities** * Inventory Management: Monitor and manage inventory levels across multiple production sites, ensuring a balance between stock availability and efficiency * Order Fulfilment: Collaborate with sales and planning teams to fulfil customer orders, ensuring that service levels are met or exceeded * Data Analysis: Utilise data to assess overall inventory positions, forecast demand, and identify trends or areas for improvement in the supply chain * Production Coordination: Engage with production teams to optimize processes, balance inventory targets, and ensure efficient use of resources across various factories * Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact between operations, sales, finance, and technical teams, explaining the logic behind decisions and ensuring alignment across functions * Problem Solving: Address and resolve issues that arise within the supply chain, adapting to variability in raw materials and changing customer demands * Quality Assurance: Ensure adherence to quality specifications, understanding that flexibility and adaptability are required due to the natural variability in livestock **Key Competencies** * Numeracy and Data-Driven: Strong ability to work with numbers and data, using analytical skills to drive decision-making * Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to managing inventory, quality specifications, and operational processes * Communication: Ability to engage with a diverse range of personalities across multiple teams, maintaining clear and effective communication * Problem Solving: Agile in evaluating and resolving issues as they arise, often needing to find the balance between efficiency and quality * Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift rapidly, requiring flexibility and quick thinking **Other Role Information** * Location: This is a site based role, learning the end to end process. There will be opportunities to travel to other Kepak sites and external locations throughout the programme * Training: Initial period of hands-on training in production areas, followed by a transition to more desk-based roles focused on data analysis and inventory management * Progression: The role is designed to develop future leaders within the company, with opportunities for progression into more senior positions after successful completion of the scheme Our Graduate programme allows dynamic, motivated, hardworking, and passionate Graduates an opportunity start their career with one of Ireland & UKs leading meat businesses. The programme lasts 2 years. **You can expect:** * To be fully immersed into our Culture from day 1, working alongside key industry experts and Kepak leaders * An opportunity to work in various departments across the business with a rotation plan tailored to your development, the rotations plan will vary by site * Gain an in depth understanding of our brands and products, and our relationships with customers and consumers * To learn key aspects of our business, whilst you develop your skills and knowledge * The opportunity to develop personally and professionally through exposure to key projects, tasks and development activities that challenge you, all supported by a detailed learner journey and training plan * A dedicated mentor and development program to support you both on the programme and into a role that best fits your skills **Start date:** September 6th 2027 **Starting Salary** - €33,500 with an up to €2,000 increase at the start of Year 2 to €35,000 **Read more about our programme and hear from some of our Graduates** ***:*** https://www.kepak.com/careers/graduates/ **Requirements** **Who are we looking for?** We are looking for hardworking and ambitious Graduates, who want to learn and grow in a challenging and fast paced environment, by performing real roles as part of your rotations. You must be mobile and willing to travel throughout the programme to undertake development activities at any of our sites in the UK and Ireland. We will consider undergraduates from all disciplines and backgrounds. **Knowledge, Skills, And Experience** * Educational Background: Open to all degree disciplines; however, a strong numeracy skill set is essential * Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools and familiarity with inventory management systems is advantageous * Industry Knowledge: A basic understanding of the meat processing industry and product specifications is beneficial * Experience: Previous experience in a similar fast-paced, data-driven environment is a plus, but not required **Personal Attributes** * Resilience: Comfortable working in a challenging environment, including exposure to abattoirs and carcass locations * Team Player: Willingness to work collaboratively across different teams and functions, sharing the load and supporting colleagues * Versatility: Capable of stepping into various roles within the supply chain, rather than specializing too narrowly in one area * Precision and Focus: A driven individual who thrives in a repetitive, detail-oriented environment We will be looking for alignment with our Core Values: **Responsibility** - Ability to work on your own initiative and take accountability for your actions **Ambition** - You will have the willingness and confidence to challenge yourself to be the best you can be and be driven to succeed **Passion for Food** - this is at the heart of everything we do, you must be passionate about every aspect of our industry **Teamwork** - ability to build positive relationships quickly with people from all cultures and career stages is pivotal **Benefits** * Employee Discount Scheme * Service-Related Annual Leave * Discounted Health Insurance * Educational Assistance/ L&D * Discounted Meat Products * Cycle to work scheme * Employee assistance programme

We will be looking for alignment with our Core Values: **Responsibility** – Ability to work on your own initiative and take accountability for your actions **Ambition** – You will have the willingness and confidence to challenge yourself to be the best you can be and be driven to succeed **Passion for Food** – this is at the heart of everything we do, you must be passionate about every aspect of our industry **Teamwork** – ability to build positive relationships quickly with people from all cultures and career stages is pivotal **Benefits** * Employee Discount Scheme * Service-Related Annual Leave * Discounted Health Insurance * Educational Assistance/ L&D * Discounted Meat Products * Cycle to work scheme * Employee assistance programme

title: Production Laboratory Administrator Grade IV
description: **Dublin Dental University Hospital (DDUH)** **Production Laboratory Administrator; Grade IV** **Permanent, Full Time Contract** The Dublin Dental University Hospital is seeking to recruit a Production Laboratory Administrator Grade IV in the Dental Laboratory Department to join the team as soon as possible. This a permanent contract, on-site role over 35 hours per week. The overall purpose of the Production Laboratory Administrator role is to work as a member of a busy team to deliver an excellent level of service to all patients, students and staff within the Hospital. The position reports to and is accountable to the Production Laboratory Manager or by any other authorised designated officer that the responsibility is delegated to by the PLM and/or the CEO. ###### **Outline of Duties and Responsibilities** The successful candidate will primarily be responsible for logging and tracking of dental laboratory cases within the production laboratory and cases being sent to external laboratories. This will also include administering Laboratory services in an efficient manner and to provide an excellent service to staff and students. The Lab Administrator typically has a wide range of responsibilities, which includes but is not limited to: * Processing of all Laboratory work entering and leaving the Lab on a daily basis. + Ensuring that all laboratory prescription sheet are filled out correctly and checking for any Non-Compliances. + Keeping track of both internal and external laboratory work where possible to ensure it is returned in a timely manner. + Liaise with external laboratories to ensure a good quality and efficient service. + Produce monthly reports detailing the volume of work passing through the laboratory with a breakdown of Cost/Units per department. + Managing queries from staff and students either in person or over the phone. + Providing Induction Laboratory training to Staff and Students at the start of each academic year. + Maintaining records, including data collection for the yearly ISO reports. + Compiling reports for ISO accreditation on a yearly basis. + Compiling the minutes at the laboratory committee meetings. + General Laboratory duties as required including but not exclusive to ensuring office administration is provided to laboratory staff. + Attending team meetings and other meetings as required. **Staff Responsibilities:** Administering Laboratory services in an efficient manner and to provide an excellent service to staff and students. The extent and speed of change in the delivery of services is such that adaptability is essential to this level of appointment. The person chosen will be required to maintain, enhance and develop their knowledge, skills and aptitudes necessary to respond to changing situations. Therefore, this job description is an outline of the current broad areas of responsibility and accountability and should not be regarded as a comprehensive listing. It will be reviewed and updated in line with future needs. ###### **Qualifications, Experience & Person Specification** Each candidate must have: * Hold a comparable and relevant third level qualification of at least level 6 on the National Qualifications Framework maintained by Qualifications and Quality Ireland, (QQI). * Previous end user experience in a Hospital setting. * Strong administration skills including the ability to manage a number of tasks simultaneously whilst maintain attention to detail. * Be focused and ability to work on their own initiative. * Be able to work as part of a team and provide day to day direction to other staff. * The ability to problem solve and find solutions to challenges. * Willingness to be flexible and adaptable. * An ability to contribute to and work effectively as a member of a team and on own initiative. * Excellent interpersonal & communication skills and the ability to relate effectively with staff and students (undergraduates and post-graduates’ levels). * Proficient in Microsoft office * Be able to demonstrate the level of autonomy with competing deadlines. It would be an advantage if the candidate has: * Ability to understand Clinical and Technical dental terms in order to process dental laboratory prescription sheets. * Has previous experience working with the Labtrac Laboratory Software. * Has previous experience working in a University, Hospital, Dental Laboratory or Private Practice setting. * A minimum of 5 years admin experience in a fast-paced environment. **General Information** **Closing date for applications is Friday 6****th** **November 2026 at noon.** **In-person interviews to be scheduled for Wednesday 18****th** **November 2026.** A job description is available upon request, please email: [email protected] . For any informal inquiries please contact Mr Ken Hall, Production Laboratory Manager [email protected] Interested candidates should submit a Cover Letter together with a copy of their Curriculum Vitae via Hirehive by clicking here ***Offers are subject to Garda Vetting, references, Safe Pass and Trade Certificate and CPD in various HSEland Training Programmes.*** ***The Dublin Dental Hospital is an equal opportunities employer.***

title: Renewable Energy Engineer (Graduate)
description: **Renewable Energy Engineer (Graduate)** **Location:** Dublin (hybrid) **Salary:** €50,000 - €60,000, depending on experience **Type:** Full-time, permanent **About us** We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland. Our growing portfolio spans onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS), and as a long-term owner we stay with every project from the first feasibility study through years of operation. Ireland has some of the best wind resources in Europe and ambitious targets for the decade ahead, and our Dublin team is growing to meet them. **What you will do** You will support engineering across our project pipeline, learning from experienced engineers while taking on real responsibility from the start. Your work will include: * Supporting engineering design and technical reviews for wind, solar and BESS projects at every stage * Preparing energy yield assessments, site evaluations and technical due diligence * Assisting with grid connection applications and coordination with EirGrid and ESB Networks processes * Reviewing technical submittals from EPC contractors, consultants and equipment suppliers * Supporting construction and commissioning, with travel to project sites across Ireland * Analysing performance data from our operating assets and recommending improvements * Contributing to the tools, templates and standards our engineering team relies on **What we are looking for** * A degree (2.1 or above) in electrical, mechanical, civil or environmental engineering, or a related field * A genuine interest in renewable energy and Ireland's energy transition * Strong analytical ability and comfort working with data and spreadsheets * Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to make technical topics simple * Initiative and curiosity: you take ownership, ask good questions and learn quickly * The right to work in Ireland * Internships, placements or project experience in energy are an advantage but not essential. We hire for aptitude and attitude, and we invest in developing our engineers. **What we offer** * €50,000 - €60,000 starting salary, depending on experience * Hybrid working from our Dublin office * A structured development path with mentorship from senior engineers * Hands-on exposure to the full project lifecycle across three technologies * Pension contributions, generous annual leave and wellbeing support * Support for professional development, including your pathway to Chartered Engineer with Engineers Ireland * The chance to grow with a company building and operating real clean energy assets **How to apply** Apply with your CV and a short note on why this role interests you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. * We are an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are available on request at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Sales Assistant -  Liffey Valley, Dublin
description: We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with over 3000 stores and web shops in countries around the world. Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behavior and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK. We have ambitious growth plans in UK and Ireland over the next 5 years and are looking for confident, passionate and ambitious employees to come on that journey with us. If you bring Dedication… You will meet Possibilities. **Job Description** Are you excited about sales? And do you want to provide JYSK in Ireland’s best customer service together with your team? Do you like variation and a fast-paced environment? Then you can be the Sales Assistant we are looking for! **What We Offer You** You get the chance to join a retail company that wants to be the candidate’s first choice when choosing an employer. We are dynamic and here your inputs get heard, you get involved and your development is crucial to us. Additionally, as JYSK ambassador, you get the following: * Opportunities for own development and responsibility – we aim to appoint 80% of our future managers internally. Learn more here. * Internal contests between stores with attractive prizes * Social activities and a fun place to work * Competitive bonus that rewards great sales results * A flexible working schedule * 20% discount at JYSK and Lars Larsen Group companies * Company pension plan * Benefits e.g. annual party, employee assistance programme, bike to work scheme and life assurance. **What Your Next Job Will Be About** * You are responsible for sales in store: you offer our customers top service with a smile! * Ensure a store that is 100% clean and well filled with our products * You will assist in receiving, unpacking and putting away the goods, both in the warehouse and in the store so you are not put off by physical work * Have the exciting opportunity to get the responsibility of your own area in the store **Meet one of our Sales Assistants and learn about how we are as an employer** **here** **.** **What You Should Bring** * You are outgoing, takes initiatives and give our customers the best shopping experience they could imagine * Have a contagious enthusiasm and enjoy talking to customers * You are a good colleague for your team – together you go the extra mile to achieve great results * Love the variety and are flexible: both in terms of tasks and in terms of hours * Enjoy time off during the week so that you can be ready for our customers during weekends at work **Additional Information** 40 hours per week JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment until we have found the right candidate. We always conduct interviews - for selected positions you can also expect to have assessments and/or a video interview, where we look forward to hearing about your motivation for the job. For more information, please visit our career page. Learn how we process your data in our Privacy Policy. To help us review applications fairly and efficiently, we use a system that automatically checks and decides how well each application matches the role. This system looks at your answers to a few screening questions. These questions were created by the system and reviewed by the JYSK Talent Acquisition team, and each question and answer have a certain value. Based on your answers, the system ranks all candidates to give us an idea of how closely the job fits your profile. This helps us manage all applications and make sure everyone is treated equally. The result from the system decides if your application moves forward to the next step. But don’t worry — the final decision is always made by a person. If you’d like to know more about how we process your personal data and your rights, please check our Privacy Policy.

title: Technical Officer – Department of Communication Design
description: **Technical Officer Department of Communication Design** **Job Description** **School/Unit:** School of Design **Post Title & Subject Area:** Technical Officer Department of Communication Design **Post Duration:** Full-Time, Permanent **Grade:** Technical Officer **Reports to:** Head of Department of Communication Design **Salary:** Technical Officer Salary Scale 47,279 - 74,919 per annum *Candidates should note that as per Department of Public Expenditure, NDP Delivery and Reform guidelines, new entrants to the civil service will be at the minimum point of the scale and the rate of remuneration will not be subject to negotiation and may be adjusted from time to time in line with Government pay policy. Different terms and conditions may apply if you are a currently serving civil or public servant.* **Hours of Attendance:** Working hours will be 35 hours per week (net of rest breaks). **Location:** This position is ordinarily based at the NCAD Campus, 100 Thomas Street, Dublin 8. The School of Design within the College comprises of 3 departments: Design for Body and Environment (BA Fashion Design, BA Jewellery & Objects, BA Textile & Surface Design and MA Design for Body & Environment). Product Design (BA and MA Product Design, BA and MA Interaction Design, MSc Medical Device Design and MA Service Design) Communication Design (BA Graphic Design, BA Illustration, BA Moving Image Design and MA Communication Design) The aim of the School of Design is to create a design culture engaged in ongoing debate on all aspects of design; a culture that thrives on new ideas, new ways of doing things and new areas of exploration. We encourage our students to experiment and take risks in order to carve new aesthetic paths and make technical innovations within, and beyond, their design discipline. We have extensive links with Industry, and students regularly work on live projects within a commercial, social or cultural context. The College seeks to ensure that our design students develop the necessary creative, technical, thinking and interpersonal skills to become highly employable graduates, entrepreneurs and thought leaders. **PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Provide technical assistance to workshop users in the techniques and processes involved in the operation of equipment in the letterpress workshop in the Department of Communication Design Demonstrate, as required, techniques and processes in the operation of the various equipment and materials in the letterpress workshop in the Department of Communication Design Help students overcome specific technical problems that they encounter Assist in supervising students in the letterpress workshop Co-operate with and provide supportive assistance to staff and students in bringing conceptual ideas to fruition Support teaching in the department and provide demonstrating and instruction in a variety of techniques and processes Assist in the design and development of practical tuition Assist in the development of student process documents Maintain and, where appropriate, construct equipment and manage materials Order, store and record appropriate materials stock Implement and adhere to all Health & Safety regulations, including maintaining accident/safety log as necessary Ensure work areas are clean and tidy to facilitate efficient and safe functioning of the workshop Engage in appropriate administrative duties particularly regarding Health & Safety, store maintenance and purchasing Undertake any other such appropriate duties which may be assigned from time to time **Selection Criteria** Selection criteria outline the qualifications, skills, knowledge and/or experience that the successful candidate would need to demonstrate for successful discharge of the responsibilities of the post. Applications will be assessed on the basis of how well candidates satisfy these criteria. **Mandatory:** Academic qualification or equivalent relevant experience in the subject area of Communication Design. An excellent understanding of typographic history and application and a working knowledge of associated software (Adobe Creative Cloud Suite). The ability to utilise and maintain a type collection to a professional standard. Ability to work as part of a team. An excellent understanding best practices for ensuring health and safety. Good organizational and solution-solving skills. Relevant technical qualification or experience in the industry or a third level educational setting Experience of working with emerging digital design technologies and in blended learning environments. Capacity and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary context within the Department, School and College. Commitment to CPD and interest in emerging research, technology, processes and techniques. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Strong leadership skills. **Desirable:** Experience of delivering skills training within a professional development context Experience in a typography led studio setting Experience in artist book-making and publishing \*A panel may be formed for this position\* **Closing date**: 9th November 2026
